ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of high-intensity white to low-intensity black pixels on the visible left lobe.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white field in the central region of the left lobe; black pigmentation border at the proximal and distal-lateral margins; small black circular spots localized near the central notch area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Estimated 85-degree V-shaped notch at the central fluke junction, partially obscured by water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous micro-serrations with pixel-amplitudes of 5-10 pixels along the visible trailing edge of the left lobe; right lobe trailing edge is null due to motion blur and water occlusion.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex parabolic sweep along the outer boundary of the left lobe; right lobe trajectory is null due to water spray occlusion.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, dark, vertically-aligned linear markings visible on the lower-left white field of the ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of calcified barnacle clusters at the distal tip of the left lobe and irregular jagged edge morphology on the trailing margin.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy occlusion of the right fluke lobe and central fluke axis by high-intensity white water spray and droplets.
